newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Carpenter has Mt Kare landowner deal.
newsitem.headline: Carpenter has Mt Kare landowner deal.

text.p: Carpenter Pacific Resources NL said on Thursday that it had agreed to give landowners a 10 percent free carried stake in the exploration licence at the Mt Kare gold prospect in the highlands of Papua New Guinea.

Carpenter said its unit Matu Mining Pty Ltd would hold 90 percent of the prospect, which it has estimated could be similar to the nearby Porgera mine which has annual output of about one million ounces a year.
It said the ownership deal was struck with Mt Kare Gold Resources Pty Ltd (MKGR), the landowner company.
Carpenter is about 33 percent owned by Oakland Pty Ltd, itself 73.2 percent owned by Ramsgate Resources NL which also sought a trading halt on its shares earlier on Thursday.
Canada's Madison Enterprises Corp has an agreement to acquire a 65 percent stake in Mt Kare once it spends A$10 million.
